evidence_scope: Registered held-out test results (register gates G2-G4); scored once after the G3 model freeze

amendments: Amendment 1 — 24 October 2026 — before test scoring — model freeze (gate G3)

tolerance.pass_rule: Probabilities within tolerance and no video decision disagreement except videos whose stored score equals the threshold

g2_probe_attempt1.note: Attempt 1 (scorer_verification_probes_validation_attempt1.json) failed only for F6_rgb: probabilities matched to 5e-16, but validation video FaceSwap/982_004 has a stored score equal to the frozen threshold (the rule draws thresholds from observed scores), so a rounding-level change flipped its >= decision. The pass rule was made boundary-aware; no threshold, head or prediction was changed.

analysis.qualification: Held-out test analysis of models, thresholds and contrasts frozen before test scoring. Intervals condition on the selected models and thresholds and omit selection and training-seed uncertainty. Additional JPEG compression of C23-derived crops; attribution is closed-set among four FF++ methods. A lower score does not show that information was physically or irreversibly erased.

P1_RGB.rule: Direction only if all three seed intervals exclude zero with the same sign

P1_PROBE.rule: Two-sided bootstrap p, Holm over the fixed six; undefined counts as p = 1

S6_shortcut_and_content.material_rule: 95% lower bound: attribution BA > 0.30, detection BA > 0.55

exploratory.label: Exploratory (register section 8)
not_computed: Label-shuffle diagnostics (validation-only fits; shuffled heads not saved)
